entries.text: The Corporeal Beast spits a core that turns your best tower against you
You hear the King Black Dragon plant himself before he breathes
The King Black Dragon sets the road alight, and travellers now wander in between waves
The interface size uses every bit of room the bar has, instead of stopping a step short
The gargoyle no longer freezes mid-air when she dies
The gargoyle dies on his own skeleton now, instead of a broken crumble
The gargoyle flinches when you hit it
Seventeen monsters that borrowed another's death cry now have their own
Scurrius and Brutus die with their own voices now
The Champion mark is a real gold trophy now, not a typed star
The common gargoyle is the Slayer Tower one again, and it crumbles into rubble when it dies
Giants, gargoyles, the mummy and their neighbours flinch and die properly now
The Road Forks is headed by a signpost now, not a compass
The trap counter no longer looks like it is counting only the trap you are holding
Spells and hitsplats now land on the Giant Mole instead of in the dirt under it
The Barrows brothers have names now — the log and the bestiary let you leaf through a monster's bodies
A box selection now finishes even when you let go outside the board
A superior is no longer a second boss, and a chinchompa's max hit grows with the wave
The Kharidian Desert fields its own nine — vultures, jackals, the kalphite hive, mummies and a dust devil
Misthalin fields its own seven — cave bugs, frogs, hobgoblins, a giant bat and a moss giant
The road forks when a boss falls, instead of every five waves
The run travels — every five waves the road forks and you choose the region you fight in next
The start screen button is called Save/Load Game, since it both exports and imports
The Roguelite card warns that the mode and its balance are still work in progress
The life and prayer orbs are round spheres with a chiselled frame instead of a bitmap rim with jagged corners
The construction button counts the towers standing on the board, the way the hunter button counts laid traps
The hunter level and the trap allowance move into a trap's hover panel, so the trap row lines up with the tower shop
A humanoid death no longer freezes in mid-air before the body settles
TzTok-Jad dies with his own animation instead of another creature's
A slain enemy settles onto the ground instead of freezing on its last frame
The life and prayer orbs carry their colour again, and their gauges drain smoothly instead of stepping
The life and prayer icons in the bottom bar wear the minimap orb behind them again
Filling a detour back in shortens it on its own side instead of flipping it to the other flank
The tower slots sit dead centre of the bottom bar, and the life and prayer gauges stretch across the space beside them
Lives and prayer are centred in the bar's empty stretch instead of hugging the interface stones
The wave leaves the bottom bar, since the Start Wave button already carries its number
Lives, wave and prayer leave the board's corner for the bottom bar, and the wave drops its always-full gauge
The same square of road can be pulled aside over and over, each tile costing the going rate and filling back in for free
The Hunter paw in the bottom bar shrinks back to icon size, so its level and XP bar fit the square again
Dig one square of road a tile aside, and fill it back in if you change your mind
